thread:
Laura: Quick sync — I've opened a small PR to move the 'Rate limit tiers' example into the new dashboard panel docs. Wanted to flag a couple of asks before I merge.
Nick: Thanks Laura. PR link? I can take a quick look at the code samples.
Laura: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — it's tiny. Main changes: new panel JSON, a compact code snippet for the SDK headers, and an updated redirect for the old /rate-limits page. The panel JSON needs a screenshot and we need to confirm the metric names.
Marta: I can run the dashboard locally and snap a screenshot. Which metric names are you expecting? is it meter.request_count or meter.consumption? :thinking_face:
Laura: meter.consumption for billing, but the panel also queries meter.request_count for latency correlation. I added both. The query labels might differ in prod; if so we'll alias in the panel.
Nick: On the SDK snippet: I trimmed it to 6 lines to fit the docs card. Here's the snippet I added — can everyone sanity-check?
DocsBot: ```js
// compact header example
const r = await Redwood.client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  headers: { 'x-rw-usage-mode': 'metering' }
})
```
Oliver: Looks fine. Suggestion: change header to x-rw-meter-mode so it reads clearer for customers. Also add a one-liner about exponential backoff for 429s.
Ben: I'll update the example in the SDK repo if we settle on header name. We should add a migration note for anyone relying on the old header name.
Marta: PR nit: the dashboard panel JSON references a datasource called "billing_prom" — in our local stack it's called "prom_billing". Laura, can you add a short line in the docs that datasource name may vary by deployment?
Laura: Good catch. I'll add a footnote. Also, can someone verify the redirect from /rate-limits -> /usage/rate-controls works? I tested locally but the site build threw one warning.
Nick: I ran the build and got a link-check warning: the old anchors in the page changed. I pushed a tiny patch to update anchor refs in the migration guide.
Laura: Awesome — thanks. Marta, can you attach the screenshot here when ready? Also we need a tiny changelog blurb for the docs release notes.
Marta: On it, will post screenshot and sizes. ETA 30 min. :camera_flash:
Oliver: I'll add the 429 backoff blurb and a one-line snippet for exponential backoff with retries (3 attempts).
Ben: Once header name is decided I'll update SDK and leave a comment in the PR linking to the SDK commit.
Laura: Plan: merge after Marta posts screenshot and after Oliver's backoff blurb. I'll queue for the next docs deploy. Thanks all :thumbsup:
DocsBot: Reminder scheduled: docs-deploy job will run after merge.
